Head to [[The Jade Quarry (Luxon)|the Jade Quarry]] and speak with [[Erek]] to help keep the [[Kurzick]]s out of the mine.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Travel to the Jade Quarry and speak to Erek.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Leaving from [[Cavalon]], travel south by southwest through [[Archipelagos]] until you reach the [[Jade Flats (Luxon)]], then head into the next outpost.

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;Elder Rhea
:''"The Kurzicks have established a mining outpost and hope to steal our precious jade. Thankfully, we got wind of their plans, and we've sent '''Erek''' there to [[Reaver|reave]] the jade before they can steal anymore of it. It's a clever plan, but Erek is only one man, and there is much jade left to mine. If you want to prove yourself a friend to the [[Luxon]]s, I suggest you travel to the '''Jade Quarry''' and aid his efforts there.''
:''Will you travel to the Jade Quarry?"''
